tailoring.headline: Backend Engineer – SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, OCC APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and microservices. Proven track record in PIM/ERP integrations, data pipeline design, performance tuning, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and production support. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, fluent in English, B1 German, and authorized to work in Germany.

cover_en.subject: Application: Backend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am excited about dormakaba’s focus on secure, high-performance access solutions and the innovative use of AI-assisted development. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs and complex e-commerce integrations that align perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: Java & Spring Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation and Shell I designed and implemented backend services using Java, Spring Framework and Spring Boot, delivering robust commerce functionality and microservices.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Extensions
bullets.text: I built and customized OCC REST services, Impex scripts, FlexibleSearch queries, cronjobs and Backoffice components, extending the platform to meet diverse B2B/B2C requirements.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: I engineered PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders and integrated SAP ERP and MDM systems, ensuring reliable product and order data flow.

bullets.label: Performance & CI/CD
bullets.text: I led database query refactoring to improve latency, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and managed Docker/Kubernetes deployments for scalable cloud operations.

cover_en.gap: I have not yet worked with AI-assisted coding agents, nor with payment or tax gateway integrations and specific API security implementations, but I am eager to acquire these skills.
cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to dormakaba.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Backend Engineer - SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_de.hook: Die Kombination aus hochsicheren Zugangslösungen und dem Einsatz von KI-unterstützter Entwicklung bei dormakaba begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Implementierung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen für Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Java- und Spring-Kenntnisse sowie umfangreiche E-Commerce-Integrationserfahrung mit.

bullets.label: Java- & Spring-Kompetenz
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich Backend-Services mit Java, Spring Framework und Spring Boot entwickelt und robuste Commerce-Funktionen bereitgestellt.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Erweiterungen
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Services, Impex-Skripte, FlexibleSearch-Abfragen, Cronjobs und Backoffice-Komponenten angepasst, um B2B- und B2C-Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Ich habe PIM-zu-Hybris-Pipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders gebaut und SAP ERP sowie MDM Systeme integriert, um konsistente Produkt- und Auftragsdaten sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Performance & CI/CD
bullets.text: Ich leitete die Optimierung von Datenbank-Abfragen, führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 durch und betreute Docker-/Kubernetes-Deployments für skalierbare Cloud-Umgebungen.

cover_de.gap: Ich habe bisher nicht mit KI-gestützten Codierungs-Agents, Zahlungs- oder Steuer-Gateways sowie speziellen API-Sicherheitsmechanismen gearbeitet, bin jedoch motiviert, diese Kenntnisse schnell zu erwerben.
cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15. Dezember 2026 und kann ab dem 16. Dezember 2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: dormakaba is a global leader in secure access solutions, continuously innovating digital lock and credential technologies. I am attracted by the company’s commitment to safety, sustainability and the opportunity to shape next-generation e-commerce platforms that integrate tightly with physical security systems. Contributing my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to such forward-thinking projects aligns with my passion for secure, high-performance digital experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to help dormakaba deliver secure, high-performance e-commerce solutions that complement its leading access-control technologies.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen on the Backend Engineer role at dormakaba and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Backend Engineer – SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Backend Engineer – SAP Commerce Cloud position at dormakaba. With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud development, Java, Spring and complex integrations, I am confident I can contribute effectively. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16 December 2026.

Thank you for your consideration.
